name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
description: Central Sector scheme providing affordable collateral-free working capital loan to street vendors to resume their livelihoods and scale their business.

benefit.description: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st tranche up to ₹10,000 (1-year repayment), 2nd tranche up to ₹20,000, 3rd tranche up to ₹50,000. Interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayment + cashback on digital transactions up to ₹1,200/year.

general: Street vendors / hawkers vending in urban, peri-urban, or rural areas on or before March 24, 2020
Vendors with Certificate of Vending / ID Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)
Vendors identified in the survey or possessing a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC)
otherConditions: Must have an Aadhaar-linked active bank account

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you a street vendor, hawker, or small mobile merchant?
Do you hold a Vending Certificate, Municipal ID, or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)?

requiredDocuments: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body ID / Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
applicationProcess: Visit PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or visit nearest CSC / Banking Correspondent (BC)
Verify Aadhaar with OTP and enter municipal ULB details
Fill vending activity details and select preferred lending institution / bank branch
Submit application; bank sanctions and disburses loan amount directly to bank account

dependsOn: Bank credit approval and ULB record match

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
aiContext: Provides ₹10k -> ₹20k -> ₹50k collateral-free working capital loan to street vendors with 7% interest subsidy on prompt repayment and ₹1,200/year cashback on digital UPI sales.

faqs.question: Is collateral or guarantor required for PM SVANidhi?
faqs.answer: No, the loan is 100% collateral-free and backed by the Credit Guarantee Fund.

faqs.question: What if I do not have a vending certificate?
faqs.answer: You can apply for a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from your local Municipality / ULB directly through the portal.

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate continuous and sustainable self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas through setting up new micro-enterprises.

benefit.amount: Subsidy up to 35% of project cost (Max project ₹50 Lakh)
benefit.description: Margin Money Subsidy of 25% (General category in urban) to 35% (Special categories including SC/ST/OBC/Women/Rural). Maximum project cost ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service sector.

general: Any individual above 18 years of age
Must have passed at least VIII standard for projects above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing or above ₹5 Lakh in service sector
Existing units or units that have already availed government subsidy under other schemes are not eligible
otherConditions: Only one person per family is eligible for assistance

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you at least 18 years of age?
Have you passed minimum 8th class (mandatory for manufacturing > 10L / service > 5L)?
Are you setting up a brand new micro-enterprise project?

requiredDocuments: Special Category / Caste Certificate (if seeking 35% subsidy)
8th Pass Mark Sheet / Highest Educational Certificate
Rural Area Certificate (issued by Sarpanch / Revenue Authority, if applicable)
applicationProcess: Apply online on KVIC PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal)
Fill applicant data, proposed business activity, district, and financing bank branch
Upload project report, caste/special category certificate, and educational proof
District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) scrutinizes application and forwards to bank
Bank sanctions loan; KVIC releases margin money subsidy into escrow lock-in account

applicationWindow.details: Online portal accepts applications throughout the year

dependsOn: DLTFC clearance and bank loan sanction

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
aiContext: Provides bank loans with 15% to 35% government subsidy for starting new businesses up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakh (service). Minimum 8th class pass.

faqs.question: What is the subsidy percentage for women and SC/ST applicants in rural areas?
faqs.answer: Special category applicants (Women, SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, Ex-servicemen, PH) in rural areas get a 35% margin money subsidy.

faqs.question: Is collateral required for PMEGP loans?
faqs.answer: No collateral is required for loans up to ₹10 Lakh (covered under CGTMSE guarantee).

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Legal guarantee for at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

benefit.description: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year per household. Wages paid within 15 days of work completion directly into the worker's Aadhaar-enabled bank or post office account.

general: Adult members of a rural household who are 18 years of age or above
Willing to do unskilled manual labour
Must be a resident of the Gram Panchayat area
otherConditions: Work must be provided within 5 km of residence, or 10% extra wage is paid

eligibilityChecks.question: Do you live in a rural area under a Gram Panchayat?
Are you willing to do unskilled manual civil/agricultural work?

requiredDocuments: Passport-size Photographs of all adult household members
Aadhaar-seeded Bank or Post Office Passbook
Existing Job Card (if applying for work allocation)
applicationProcess: Apply in writing or orally to the Gram Panchayat for a MGNREGA Job Card
Gram Panchayat verifies household residence and issues Job Card within 15 days
Submit demand for work (Form 6) at Gram Panchayat / Grama Sachivalayam
Work must be allotted within 15 days, otherwise Unemployment Allowance is legally mandated

applicationWindow.details: Job cards and work demand can be registered at any time

processingTime.estimated: 15 days for Job Card issuance / 15 days for work allocation

aiContext: Provides 100 days of guaranteed unskilled manual wage employment to rural adults. Wages paid directly to bank/post office accounts within 15 days.

faqs.question: What happens if work is not provided within 15 days of demand?
faqs.answer: The state government is legally obligated to pay a daily Unemployment Allowance.

faqs.question: Are women prioritized under MGNREGA?
faqs.answer: Yes, by law at least one-third of all beneficiaries must be women, and equal wages are guaranteed.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Provides collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across three categories: Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun.

benefit.description: Collateral-free loan: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 Lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous Tarun loans).

general: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm income generating activity
Manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector micro-units
Should not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution
otherConditions: No processing fee for Shishu and Kishore loans

eligibilityChecks.question: Is your business activity in manufacturing, trading, retail, services, or food processing?
Do you have a clean repayment record without bank NPA status?

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card
Business Address Proof / Udyam Registration Certificate
Bank Account Statement for the last 6 months
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased (for term loans)
applicationProcess: Apply online on Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any Commercial Bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or MFI
Select loan category (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun)
Submit application with business plan and identity documents
Bank sanctions Mudra loan and issues Mudra Debit Card for working capital

applicationWindow.details: Continuous application at all public, private, and rural bank branches

ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
aiContext: Provides collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakh across Shishu (≤50k), Kishore (50k-5L), and Tarun (5L-20L) for shops, trading, manufacturing, and services.

faqs.question: Is collateral required for a Mudra loan?
faqs.answer: No collateral or third-party guarantee is required for any Mudra loan up to ₹20 Lakh.

faqs.question: What is the Mudra Card?
faqs.answer: A RuPay debit card providing working capital facility so the borrower can withdraw funds as and when required.
